dedupe_keys.name: tiled sidewalk pavement defect image dataset for yolov5 based object detection

description: Tiled Sidewalk Pavement Defect Image Dataset for YOLOv5-Based Object Detection is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yaser Bagheri, mohammadreza ahmadian. This dataset contains mobile phone photographs of tiled urban sidewalks and curb segments, annotated at the level of individual pavement units, not by region, to support object-oriented detection of sidewalk defects. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 16095424197 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
